I m having a confusion about make up exam

@21f3000759

I won’t be able to be present in end term , i gave system commands oppe 1 and couldn’t score passing marks

Will I be able to give make up exam for both et and oppe in next term ?

Do I need to be present in reoppe too in order to give make up exam ?

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: You will have to repeat the whole course. But if you pass the re-oppe then you can just give end term exam in the upcoming term.
